sources.snippet: A couple weeks ago, we released JaColBERTv2.5, using an updated ColBERT training recipe to create the state-of-the-art Japanese retrieval model. Today, we're introducing a new model, answerai-colbert-small-v1 (🤗), a proof of concept for smaller, faster, modern ColBERT models.
